objective: Exploratory matched A/B/C pilot of long Ultracode Workflow children: rank observed non-inferior arms by all-attempt weighted child cost per successful task; no persistent adoption from three repetitions.

sources.verification: gh api contents/CHANGELOG.md?ref=v2.1.283 resolved download_url; fetched that pinned raw URL with ctx_fetch_and_index

sources.limitation: Closed-source client: live schema documentation plus supplied installed-version/changelog review, not source proof of event completeness.

sources.disposition: Source and skills.sh listing inspected; package/log guidance does not supply these task oracles. No installation.

research_disposition: Source-backed extension of the existing document/contract-test seam. Native Claude OTel -> existing collector -> Loki is the request instrument; ccusage v20.0.26 reconciles sessions; Inspect 0.3.271 match scorers grade canonical independent records through thin adapters. No inspect_swe bridge: it changes launch defaults/context selection. Installed Inspect metadata is 0.3.266, so pinned scorer execution remains unqualified. No host changes, Claude sessions or installations in this repair.

native_lever.precedence: Environment variable overrides /autocompact, --autocompact and autoCompactWindow. Identical --autocompact auto neutralizes a saved window for A without editing settings.
native_lever.workflow_inheritance: Not established by an explicit guarantee for this variable in the inspected primary sources. Subagents share main-conversation compaction logic; applying the session environment to Workflow children is an inference that requires native treatment evidence.
native_lever.per_agent_control: Not found in installed 2.1.283 --help, the changelog through v2.1.283, or the inspected Workflow/subagent configuration documentation. This is a scoped search finding, not a claim that an undocumented API cannot exist.
native_lever.process_isolation: One new headless coordinator process per task/arm/repetition. Do not change the variable inside a coordinator or put multiple treatments in sibling children.

treatment_proof.configuration: Retain only the launch's selected variable value/unset marker, common configuration digest and version. Inspect resolved non-secret settings and the child's effective context/model metadata before judging treatment; inherited env blocks must not reintroduce another value.
treatment_proof.sdk_event: SDK streams use compact_metadata.trigger and compact_metadata.pre_tokens; do not parse them as native JSONL fields or count both copies.
treatment_proof.context_measure: Per deduplicated assistant request, prompt_tokens = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens. Record maximum and the last prompt before/first after each boundary. Never substitute cumulative cache reads for context size.
treatment_proof.B_and_C: Every focal child must have at least one automatic boundary. All automatic preTokens must be within 10% of its assigned threshold: B 360000..440000, C 180000..220000 inclusive. These are conservative experimental validity bands, not an upstream timing guarantee. Outside-band or missing evidence makes the run incomplete; do not widen bands after observing results.
treatment_proof.A: Every focal child must exceed 400000 prompt tokens. If it auto-compacts, preTokens must be in 870300..1000000 inclusive (approximately 967000). If it never compacts, retain that right-censored observation and the verified default launch; do not invent an event at 967000.
treatment_proof.exclusions: Any manual compaction, context-limit recovery compaction, continuation as a replacement child, unresolved fallback, or context cap invalidates the matched comparison, with usage retained. Native automatic compaction in the same child is the treatment.

shared_controls.provider: Existing native Claude subscription on the Anthropic API route with native 1M support; no gateway, paid credits or provider switch

command_wrapper.restriction: Only literal command execution without interpretation; any verification or judgment stays Opus.

shared_controls.agent_definitions: Byte-identical examples/claude-native agent definitions from the reference revision, explicitly passed per stage with model and effort; bind their digests at sealing.
shared_controls.token_lanes_carrier: Keep the reference revision's saved-workflow/agent-body token-lane text and SubagentStart configuration identical. First-prompt evidence must show the carrier in Workflow children; Agent-tool hook acceptance alone is insufficient.
shared_controls.mcp: Same resolved MCP names, versions, grants, deferred discovery, output schema and Context Mode/RTK versions for every arm; seal a sanitized configuration fingerprint before launch. Separate fresh per-attempt task indexes; no warm research results from another arm.
shared_controls.cache: Workflow children use the native 5-minute TTL; verify no subagentPromptCacheTtl=1h or forcing override. Keep default prefix stagger and all caching behavior unchanged. Coordinator 1-hour cache may persist: record separately; excluded from the child cost estimand.
shared_controls.other_constraints: Auto-compaction on, fast mode off, no model fallbacks, no context-window or cache-TTL override, same native authentication and permissions, no session resume, no persistent settings edits. Abort on control drift. Seal all effective non-secret settings; never dump the environment.
shared_controls.worktree_rule: Use one owned disposable worktree per attempt at the frozen revision, with only the identical sealed packet/oracle overlay. Keep original task inputs immutable. Worktree ordinal and arm are metadata, not model instructions. No other checkout is a write target.

frozen_corpora.serialization: For local inventories: sorted path list selected from git ls-tree -r at reference_revision; objects {path,sha256} from original blob bytes; UTF-8 JSON, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), no trailing newline. Never enumerate the changing worktree.

python_sources.selector: All tracked .py under scripts/ and tests/ at reference_revision

test_modules.selector: Tracked tests/test_*.py at reference_revision, excluding any file whose original UTF-8 source matches the skip_exclusion_regex
test_modules.qualification: This deliberately conservative static subset removes explicit skip declarations even in test strings. It is not a claim that every remaining dependency is ready or that indirect skips are impossible; any skip or unavailable dependency still fails readiness. Selection is fixed before model observation.

workflow_sources.selector: All tracked files under examples/claude-native/ at reference_revision

python_docs.selector: All blobs under Doc/library/ ending .rst, path sorted, from the recursive Git tree at revision; tree response must not be truncated
python_docs.serialization: UTF-8 JSON array of {path,sha,size} from the Git tree, path sorted, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), no trailing newline; sha is the upstream Git blob id, not SHA256
python_docs.reason: Pinned primary documentation for the Python-based repository's JSON, filesystem, subprocess and test tooling. Expands the prior two-page research check into a complete source-documentation inventory, without mutable /3/ pages.

tasks.reuse_scope: Reuse the owned-worktree, actual-base and test-first isolation contract only. The greeting fixture is too short; this is a new real accounting feature, not a repeat of its accepted result.
tasks.prompt: In your assigned worktree, verify the base before editing. Review every frozen Python source and Workflow source for accounting compatibility, in path order, keeping a compact per-file definition/counter inventory. Then test-first add exported compactionSummary(rows) to examples/claude-native/workflows/child-usage.mjs using the frozen vectors and the native compact_boundary schema. Write the regression test, run it red before changing implementation, implement, run it green and rerun the unchanged existing test-child-usage.mjs. Preserve existing output/API behavior. Return the inventory, changed-path list and actual red/green results. Only child-usage.mjs and a new examples/claude-native/workflows/test-compaction-summary.mjs may change. Do not commit, install, call providers or split the work into new children.
tasks.long_child_workload: One persistent Workflow child reviews 224 Python files and 26 Workflow files, then performs the test-first feature and compatibility verification. Each distinct source has a bounded checkpoint, not a repeated dump. Whole-session thinking, retained review decisions and implementation should exercise the measured long-child population; length is a required observed eligibility condition, not assumed from bytes or turn count.

checks.procedure: Independently compare the actual worktree base, final git diff names and native test-call ordering. The first regression run must fail because compactionSummary is absent, before implementation changes; the identical test bytes must later pass.
checks.expected: Exact frozen base; separate owned worktree; changed paths a subset of the two authorized paths including child-usage.mjs; red exit nonzero then green exit 0; original test-child-usage.mjs bytes unchanged and node examples/claude-native/workflows/test-child-usage.mjs exits 0.

checks.procedure: In a separate verifier process import compactionSummary from the candidate module; apply every builder_oracle vector and compare exact JSON. Also recompute source coverage against the immutable corpus, never the patched files.
checks.expected: All vector outputs equal the frozen literal expected objects; output order preserved; no input mutation; coverage has exactly the 250 frozen paths and correct original SHA256 values, without duplicates.

tasks.reuse_scope: Reuse its JSON/pathlib facts and rows 5..12 table check; adapt URLs to immutable CPython source and add a fixed documentation-inventory workload. Do not label this expanded bundle the unchanged historical task.
tasks.prompt: Build the repository's Python dependency-documentation inventory from every frozen python_docs page, in path order, using ctx_fetch_and_index. For each page record its exact URL, Git blob identity and every column-zero RST '.. module:: NAME' declaration in source order; retain bounded source evidence for the summary. Review each distinct page with a compact checkpoint and keep all state in this one Workflow child. Finally answer the inherited JSON/pathlib question and return all original fields/types of table records 5 through 12 and their integer latency sum. Required facts: allow_nan=false rejects non-finite encoding with ValueError; Path.read_text accepts encoding. Cite the corresponding immutable json.rst and pathlib.rst captures. Return a structured report; no full-page dumps or new subagents.
tasks.long_child_workload: 319 distinct primary-source pages, 6,905,092 frozen source bytes, reviewed in one child through ctx_fetch_and_index; no artificial context padding. Short retrieval is still required. Every A repetition must independently exceed 400000 observed prompt tokens despite containment; otherwise the design did not reproduce the target population.

checks.procedure: Compare report rows with the frozen Git tree inventory, original blob bytes and native ctx_fetch_and_index call/capture records. Extract declarations using multiline regex ^\.\. module::[ \t]+([^\r\n]+), trimming captured names.
checks.expected: Exactly 319 unique pages, exact immutable URLs/blob ids and declarations including empty lists; each page actually fetched via ctx_fetch_and_index; retained source bytes match upstream Git blob identity. Any missing, mismatched or silently substituted page fails.

checks.procedure: Strictly decode returned table rows and compare with input rows whose id is 5..12 inclusive, preserving types; compute latency sum from originals. Require the two pinned capture identities and structured fact values nonfinite_exception and read_text_encoding_parameter. Each citation supplies inclusive 1-based start/end lines in the ORIGINAL RST blob. Reject out-of-range spans; require at most 30 lines and the corresponding frozen citation_predicates' literal substrings within that span.
checks.expected: Exact selected records/types and integer latency sum; nonfinite_exception='ValueError'; read_text_encoding_parameter='encoding'; both exact source identities and literal citation predicates pass. No semantic-support judgment is part of the boolean.

tasks.reuse_scope: Reuse the complete partition-5 acceptance command, fixture identity, exit and literal summary. Extend with the pinned repository's fixed 97-module candidate offline subset, twice; interpretation remains Opus.
tasks.prompt: Verify the frozen repository without edits. In one Workflow child, inspect and run each of the 97 frozen candidate offline test modules in sorted path order using python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p BASENAME -v, capturing output through ctx_execute and deriving bounded summaries. Re-run the same complete ordered module list once, preserving both rounds' outcomes. Interpret every failure without repairing or silently retrying it. Then run the original seed-acceptance-5 command and python3 scripts/validate.py. Return command vectors, native exit codes, nonzero test counts, failures/skips and exact final summaries with output hashes. Do not install, call a provider, rerun beyond the two rounds, or spawn new children.
tasks.long_child_workload: 194 distinct module-round verification obligations, source inspection and diagnosis of retained failures, plus the exact inherited log acceptance and repository validator, all in one child. Repetition tests stability; it is fixed in advance, not repeated until context qualifies.

checks.procedure: Independently reconcile the native tool-call ledger with the immutable 97-module inventory and both ordered rounds. Compare each submitted exit/count/summary with its actual captured process output, not the child's asserted passed flag.
checks.expected: Exactly 194 prescribed module commands, all exit 0, each runs at least one test, no failures/errors/unexpected successes/skips; no source edits. Any unavailable dependency or unsafe/non-offline module blocks readiness rather than silently dropping it.

checks.procedure: Verify frozen events bytes; independently observe the unchanged seed-acceptance-5 command from the source preregistration and the validator's command output.
checks.expected: Partition command exit 0 and exact final summary PASS partition 5, emitted from the 640-row/10-ERROR fixture whose final event is 640; validator exit 0 and status passed. Full 84003-byte log stays outside model context.

tasks.reuse_scope: Keep the exact patch/counts/interrupt-contract check, preceded by a fixed source inventory and accounting review. Existing short patch task alone is not a long-context benchmark.
tasks.prompt: Review every frozen Python and Workflow source in sorted path order in one persistent Workflow child. Produce a compact coverage ledger of original SHA256 and, for Python files, every FunctionDef/AsyncFunctionDef/ClassDef name, kind and lineno sorted by (lineno, col_offset, kind, name), using ast.walk. Investigate how usage is deduplicated and failed attempts are retained; report those frozen fact probes with source lines. At the end review run-efba31d5.patch without applying it, returning its exact structural counts and the interrupt-contract changes. Keep per-file analysis bounded, preserve exact original source for verification, and make no edits or additional children.
tasks.long_child_workload: 224 real Python sources plus 26 Workflow files, compatibility/counter review and the 52631-byte patch, all in one child. This is a long source-audit task, with deterministic coverage and regression facts as the scored subset; unscored prose is not a quality win.

checks.procedure: Independently regenerate source hashes and the specified AST inventory from the frozen Git blobs and compare exact structured coverage. Check the three literal accounting fact values; citations must name the pinned child-usage.mjs and include the corresponding inclusive original line spans: usage_dedup_key 458..458, usage_duplicate_choice 460..460, superseded_usage_included 542..548. Each span may have at most five extra lines on either side; reject other source identities or out-of-range spans.
checks.expected: Exactly 250 unique original paths and exact inventories; usage_dedup_key='message.id or row.uuid'; usage_duplicate_choice='largest output_tokens'; superseded_usage_included=true; all three deterministic citation span predicates pass.

checks.procedure: Apply the unchanged seed-review-diff oracle to the original patch; compare literal count fields and interrupt-contract booleans. Confirm the patch was not applied.
checks.expected: file=run.py; hunks=31; added=166; deleted=581 excluding +++/--- headers; removed_signal_names=['SIGINT','SIGTERM','SIGHUP']; removed_SIGKILL_status_started_exception=true; preserves_no_overwrite=true; repository unchanged.

builder_oracle.source: Pinned child-usage.mjs deduplication/counter conventions and official native_compaction transcript schema. These author-written vectors are synthetic fixtures, not upstream tests.
builder_oracle.contract: compactionSummary(rows) is a pure exported function. Count only native system/compact_boundary rows; auto events retain pre_tokens in order, manual events are counted separately. Compute max prompt tokens from deduplicated assistant messages using the original module's greatest-output rule. Count distinct assistant identities with no usage object as missing. Input rows are not mutated.
builder_oracle.independence: The experiment's accounting and compaction extraction remain the sealed baseline tools plus independent native event inspection. Never use the builder candidate as the instrument measuring its own arm.

execution.reset_rule: Begin readiness immediately after the specified reset; verify actual reset in /usage. A different reset, unsealed draft or unmet gate postpones the run; never silently start another week or run this draft.
execution.schedule_algorithm: For repetition index 0..2, visit task_order_by_repetition[index]; run its three arms in order_by_task[task][index]. Each task occupies each arm-position once; all six permutations occur twice overall. Do not reorder after failures.
execution.washout: Wait at least 360 seconds after the last request and process-group termination before the next attempt, including same-model wrapper work. Verify 5-minute child TTL. No other Claude use during the experiment. Within-child cache reuse stays native; first-request cache read is measured, not assumed zero.
execution.retries: No replacement attempts or human repair within this run. Native provider retries remain part of the original attempt's usage. Ordinary completed task failures remain scored failures; protocol interruptions or restarts stop the whole run as incomplete.
execution.eligibility: All 12 A focal children must exceed 400000 per-request prompt tokens; all 24 B/C focal children must demonstrate automatic compaction in their assigned validity bands. No padding, wider bands, dropping tasks or adding turns after seeing a short/failing run. Preserve all records and stop incomplete on the first violated eligibility condition.

precision.variance_source: No independent pilot variance for paired task costs exists. Max-effort output, tool trajectory, compaction work and cache reuse vary within task; task heterogeneity cannot be treated as independent repeats of one task.
precision.supported_claim: Three repeats give position balance, observed ranges and a descriptive finite-suite ranking only. They do not establish a repeatable 10% saving, statistical quality non-inferiority, 95% confidence or general adoption.
precision.illustrative_precision: For independent approximately normal paired relative cost differences d, a two-sided 95% t interval has half-width t(0.975,n-1)*s_d/sqrt(n). At n=3, t=4.303: half-width is 2.484*s_d. A half-width <=0.10 would require s_d<=0.0403, which is unmeasured. This illustration is not an interval for the failure-inclusive ratio of sums and not a power calculation.
precision.future_design: Use an independent pilot to estimate within-task paired variation and task/check discordance, then preregister a fresh confirmatory cohort and simultaneous inference for both candidates and per-task gates. For mean-difference planning, solve t(0.975,n-1)*s_d/sqrt(n)<=h at the chosen precision h; the actual ratio-per-success needs an appropriate paired ratio/failure model. No numerical confirmatory n is asserted without variance.
precision.stability: Report paired costs, check outcomes and ranges by task/repetition. Recompute the same descriptive decision leaving out each complete repetition block in turn (all tasks/all arms together); a changed ranking or loss of any 10% gate is unstable. This sensitivity check is not a confidence interval and cannot promote a pilot winner to adoption.

quality.source: Inspect 0.3.271 match scorers over canonical independent observed/target records from the eight thin adapter contracts; no model self-reported pass flags.
quality.denominator: Two checks per task attempt, 24 check opportunities and 12 task attempts per arm
quality.success: A task succeeds only when every frozen check passes; report each boolean, pass count and successful-task count. Missing evidence is unknown, never pass.

child_usage.source: Authoritative request_ledger OTel rows attributed to focal/wrapper children; unchanged baseline child-usage.mjs is an independent transcript cross-check only.
child_usage.window: Entire fresh Workflow attempt, first request through final/interrupted record, including every failed, restarted or superseded child attempt
child_usage.denominator: Per attempt, per model, and all assigned attempts per successful task within each arm/task and pooled arm
child_usage.aggregation: Sum the four counters from deduplicated child-attributed request IDs once per model. Include compaction, background preparation, retries, refusals and failed/interrupted work. Do not add child-usage.mjs, ccusage, coordinator cumulative results or /usage totals. Missing counters or unresolved request ownership invalidate comparison.

weighted_cost.unit: USD-equivalent at dated public standard API rates, not subscription billing
weighted_cost.formula: W = sum_over_models((p_input*input_tokens + p_write*cache_creation_input_tokens + p_read*cache_read_input_tokens + p_output*output_tokens)/1000000); cost_per_success = sum(W across ALL assigned attempts)/successful_task_count
weighted_cost.normalized_weights: Opus 5.5: 1,1.25,0.05,5. Sonnet 5: 1,1.25,0.1,5. Never sum these differently based normalized units across models; the dollar-equivalent W is the common weighted total.
weighted_cost.zero_successes: Undefined, not zero cost; no candidate adoption if any compared task/arm has zero successes.
weighted_cost.separation: Keep all four token categories separately. Thinking is already in output; do not add transcript bytes or reasoning tokens again. A 1-hour write, unknown model/tier or missing pricing/usage invalidates the comparison. No >200K premium for these models at these rates.

compaction.source: Native per-child compact_boundary records and deduplicated provider prompt counters; sdk_compaction only as a separately identified schema
compaction.denominator: Each event and each child; event count, preTokens, last-before/first-after request prompt tokens, maximum prompt tokens
compaction.missing: No event is a valid censored A observation only with complete transcript; missing transcript/context is unknown.

wall_time.source: Supervisor monotonic timestamps corroborated by native journal start/end
wall_time.window: Coordinator launch to process-group exit for an attempt; separately child first-to-last record
wall_time.denominator: Seconds per attempt; all-attempt seconds per successful task; total scheduled elapsed also includes washouts
wall_time.failures: Failed/interrupted wall time retained; process liveness is not completion.

weekly_quota.source: Native /usage value-only weekly buckets and reset timestamp, before readiness and after settled final shutdown
weekly_quota.denominator: Percentage points within each unchanged weekly bucket; never aggregate overlapping buckets
weekly_quota.aggregation: Report per-bucket end minus baseline with reading age and reset identity. Missing/stale readings stay unknown. Cached /usage is not the token stop instrument or a conversion to subscription charge.

coordinator.source: Coordinator-owned rows in the same request_ledger; always included in the run token budget, reported separately from child cost.
coordinator.denominator: Per attempt, separately from child cost
coordinator.boundary: Exclude child-inclusive cumulative totals; do not add these observations to overlapping reports. Coordinator cache may last 1 hour. A claim about whole-session quality per token would require a separate matched design.

request_ledger.instrument: Claude Code native OTel api_request events
request_ledger.scope: One private launch/session registry maps owned processes to task/arm/repetition, parent, focal child and wrappers. Capture every request from launch/readiness through final settled shutdown; retain coordinator usage separately from child cost.
request_ledger.event_name_note: OTel event body/name can be claude_code.api_request while event.name is api_request; qualify the actual Loki mapping before sealing, not a text search of content-omitted bodies.
request_ledger.attribute_scope: All four counters and a request_id are mandatory for a metered api_request. Agent/Workflow/parent fields apply when native events provide them; absent main-session parent fields are not invented. Errors/refusals without counters remain unresolved until joined to a metered request or provider evidence establishes no usage.
request_ledger.query: Read GET /loki/api/v1/query_range with a sealed service/session selector, fixed start/end nanoseconds and direction=forward. Poll every 1 second using overlapping ranges from launch through now. Page/split until no response is limit-truncated; retain every page and its query interval. A full page, missing interval or error cannot be a complete ledger. Re-query the whole interval after shutdown/drain.

deduplication.rule: Identical retransmitted events collapse once across overlapping queries and exporter retries. Different provider request IDs count separately even under one client request/retry chain. Join error/refusal events onto the request row; they do not add counters. Missing request ID remains unknown; never use timestamps or message text as a substitute.

request_ledger.join: Join transcript response/provider request ID to OTel request_id; retain the qualified transcript-field mapping. Use client_request_id plus attempt to link retry chains, not to deduplicate distinct provider requests. Use native session/Workflow/agent lineage to attribute compact and background requests even if no assistant message exists. Each request has exactly one owner. compact_boundary is treatment evidence, not a usage row.
request_ledger.fallback: Inspect resolved model and api_refusal.server_fallback_hop as well as launch model. Retain fallback usage in the budget, invalidate the matched cost comparison on any fallback, and keep unreported fallback charge unknown. Never filter fallback/error requests out to make totals agree.

reconciliation.scope: Run offline for every owned native session after settled exit. Explicitly map focal/wrapper transcripts and parent session scope; prove whether this pin includes each child before comparing like scopes. The transcript helper supplies a separate child attribution check, not the primary total.
reconciliation.equation: For each session/model/token category: OTel_total = ccusage_total + OTel_only - ccusage_only. Each residual must be enumerated by private request ID and native source, with complete four-category usage. Expected final ccusage_only=0. OTel-only compact/background usage may be legitimate if independently attributed and metered; equal totals alone do not prove coverage.
reconciliation.absence_rule: No usage row is not proof of zero charge. Retain error/refusal/timeout/cancelled requests with unknown counters unless authoritative evidence resolves them; any unresolved amount stops selection.

qualification.note: Repository observability/collector/collector.yaml allowlist omits request_id, client_request_id and agent_id. Existing running collector is user-specified, but active sanitized request/child joins were not observed. Do not change the collector in this repair or silently substitute session sums. Gate launch on preserved native IDs and reconciled coverage.

decision_rule.quality_rule: For every task and check, any pass in A requires a pass in every repetition of the candidate.
decision_rule.pass_count_rule: Candidate total passed checks and successful tasks must each be at least A's totals.
decision_rule.cost_rule: All-attempt weighted child cost per successful task must be at least 10% lower than A, both pooled and for each task.
decision_rule.selection_rule: Among quality-eligible candidates meeting the 10% pooled and per-task cost margin versus A, choose the unique lowest pooled all-attempt weighted child cost per successful task; an exact cost tie yields no selection and retains A.
decision_rule.incomplete_rule: Any stopped, invalid, underlength, or unmeasured run is incomplete; no adoption result.
decision_rule.completeness_gate: All 36 prescribed attempts and their independent check results, usage and treatment evidence are available, with every eligibility/control/seal gate passed. Completed ordinary task failures count; no imputation or best-of repetitions.
decision_rule.cost_test: For each candidate independently (no arm order): for each task and the pool require successes(A)>0, successes(X)>0 and CPS(X)<=0.90*CPS(A). Among qualifying quality-non-inferior candidates minimize pooled CPS. Use exact decimal/rational rates and unrounded token totals. No additional effect threshold between B and C; equal minima give no selection, not a larger-cost winner.
decision_rule.interpretation: An exploratory finite frozen-suite ranking only. The quality rules operationalize observed non-inferiority, not a statistical confidence bound. Three repetitions and the 10% observed margin do not support persistent adoption or generalization; future confirmation requires an independently preregistered cohort. Equal task relevance is protected by the per-task margin; pooled cost is the explicit ranking objective.
overturn_conditions: A matched frozen check regresses after adoption
A repeat with the same sealed inputs loses the 10% cost margin
A client/model/compaction-policy/TTL/token-lane change invalidates the treatment or weights
An independent accounting audit finds missing, duplicated, fallback or misattributed usage
A larger independently sealed real-task suite contradicts the result
decision_rule.reopen_evidence: A dated amendment with pinned changed inputs/reason and a new complete counterbalanced cohort, independent oracle evidence, native treatment/usage records and all previous failed/stopped attempts. Anecdotes, source claims or selectively rerun winners cannot reopen adoption.
decision_rule.worked_example_scope: Every task has these same CPS values; all controls and completeness gates hold. Quality eligibility is as listed. Selected means descriptive pilot candidate, not authorization to change a host.

other_stops: Wrong actual worktree base or forbidden file edit
Unproven Workflow treatment, manual compaction, missing boundary, out-of-band compaction or underlength A child
Unsafe or non-offline fixture/check dependency discovered
Any interrupted coordinator/child, transcript gap or unscheduled restart
stop_rules.reporting: Retain failed and interrupted attempts, all known usage, unknown fields as null, native error category, cap/termination reason and incomplete status. A stopped run never selects a window. No retry in another weekly window without an append-only amendment and new cohort.

token_budget.rationale: A fixed proposed resource ceiling for this draft, not a conversion of the former weekly-percent allowance, billing guarantee or evidence that the 36 attempts fit. It includes cache reads once, unlike a monetary budget.
token_budget.observed_tokens: Sum all four native categories over the deduplicated request_ledger, including coordinators, children, preparation, compactions, wrappers, retries, failures, refusals, fallbacks and interruptions.
token_budget.admission: Before every launch require observed_tokens + outstanding_reserve_tokens < limit_tokens and a healthy qualified observer. Stop scheduling at the first trigger. Readiness/model requests, if later authorized, use this same budget; no unmetered calibration probes.

reporting_lag.procedure: For retained permitted native request receipts, join provider completion/OTel event time to first query-visible Loki arrival while polling every P=1 second on a synchronized clock; record query errors, clock uncertainty, min/p50/p95/max and sample count, including compact/error/refusal paths. First query visibility gives an upper sample lag after adding clock uncertainty; event.timestamp is not ingest time. Do not read prompt bodies.
reporting_lag.interpretation: The documented default log export interval is not a measured reporting lag or a worst-case delivery bound. Observed maxima/percentiles cannot establish a deterministic future L_bound; native export retries can delay delivery.

variables.R_max: Proven maximum total of all four token categories for one accepted provider request across all permitted resolved models, including compaction/fallback; cache categories partition input, not duplicate it.
variables.N_active_max: Enforced maximum simultaneous uncompleted requests in all owned coordinator/child/background/retry paths, not merely the number of focal children.
variables.lambda_max: Enforced upper request-completion rate per second with bursts covered by N_active_max; an observed mean/max is insufficient.
variables.L_bound: Enforced upper time from request completion to observer visibility, including exporter queue, transport, Loki query delay and clock uncertainty.
variables.K_bound: Proven maximum stop-trigger-to-last-request-admission delay across the owned tree, including TERM grace, KILL and OS scheduling.

outstanding_bound.required_proof: A finite bound requires enforceable request admission/concurrency/rate and delivery/cancellation bounds for every native hidden path, or an upstream pre-admission token reservation mechanism that bounds all unreported requests even during telemetry outage. Post-response api_request events alone provide neither. Keep every unresolved value null; one coordinator/one child and a 5-second export interval do not prove them.
outstanding_bound.provider_charge: Include the FULL allowed charge of all active and admitted-but-unreported requests; killing a client does not undo a server-accepted request. Unknown charge cannot be set to zero. No subscription-percent or dollar cap is inferred.

cancellation.launch: Future supervisor uses subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True) and records PID, PGID, process start identity and descendant membership. Verify all experiment descendants remain in the owned group; escaping descendants block readiness. No global pkill, collector shutdown or signal to unrelated sessions.
cancellation.procedure: Latch stop and prevent further launches. Verify recorded ownership/start identity, signal os.killpg(pgid, SIGTERM), wait up to 5 seconds, then SIGKILL surviving owned group members. Wait/reap every owned process and independently verify the group is gone. Keep the observer/collector alive to drain and reconcile late events. A PID/ownership mismatch is an uncontained-stop error, never successful cleanup.
cancellation.qualification: Exercise ownership, escalation, descendant cleanup and observer liveness on offline disposable processes before sealing; retain monotonic durations. No cancellation was exercised in this repair.

token_budget.health: Query failure, missing/truncated page, counter/ID gap, lag above a sealed bound, observer failure, other Claude activity or failed cancellation immediately latches stop and incomplete. An independent supervisor watchdog must enforce observer liveness. An outage still needs pre-admission bounds; stop-on-outage alone cannot promise no overshoot.
token_budget.settlement: After owned exit, drain at least the qualified delivery bound and perform two full ledger reads one polling period apart plus offline ccusage reconciliation. Equality of snapshots is necessary but not proof of no lost events. Any unresolved request keeps the run incomplete and charged usage unknown.
token_budget.current_status: not_supported_as_a_proven_hard_cap: no measured lag, enforceable request bounds or cancellation receipt is available under this no-session repair. Token stop policy is specified; execution remains blocked.
